listening_script.speed_note: Read aloud at a normal, clear pace (85 wpm). Pause 2–3 seconds between sentences. Read the full text twice before students answer questions.
listening_script.text:
Plants are amazing! They can make their OWN food.
This process is called PHOTOSYNTHESIS.
WHAT PLANTS NEED:
1. SUNLIGHT (from the sun)
2. WATER (from the soil, through roots)
3. CARBON DIOXIDE (from the air, through leaves)
WHAT PLANTS MAKE:
1. GLUCOSE (sugar - food for the plant)
2. OXYGEN (released into the air - we breathe this!)
THE PROCESS:
Step 1: Leaves absorb sunlight.
Step 2: Roots absorb water from soil.
Step 3: Leaves take in carbon dioxide from air.
Step 4: Inside the leaf, these combine to make glucose.
Step 5: Oxygen is released as a byproduct.
This is why plants are GREEN!
The green color comes from CHLOROPHYLL, which captures sunlight.
Plants give us oxygen. Thank you, plants!
Science Vocabulary:
dictation: They can make their OWN food.
